name: Lingoken
tagline: The activity maker for language teachers
maker_comment_excerpt: Hello Product Hunt 👋 I am Sumeeti and I've built Lingoken, a platform for language teachers to make learning super fun and engaging. I grew up speaking Sindhi, Hindi, and Marathi. When I went to college and was exposed to some more regional languages, I realised I really love them. I like how when you try and learn someone's language, it makes them warm up to you a bit more. And that feels like someone opening the door to a whole new culture for you. Learning about some common idioms and phrase
